notes.title: NEW: Voidling Assault Is Better
notes.content:
You thought I was dead? No way. I canonically can't die. I've been hard at work making Voidling Assault even better than it was before. 

Here are just a few of the improvements to the Voidling Assault experience... 

[list]
[*] [b]Arena Improvements[/b] - A beautiful wavy background! You won't get lost anymore. Also, the camera is less crazy. If you were experiencing motion sickness before, you should now be experiencing pure and unadulterated [i]motion harmony[/i].
[*] [b]Feeding Minigame[/b] - Well, calling it a minigame is a stretch. You can massage the purple grid of a Kyztling in the Ky Fragment to make him digest faster. Or her. Whatever their pronoun. You should really ask first though.
[*] [b]Writing Tweaks[/b] - You know what they say about first drafts! They're never perfect. Well, as it turns out, this draft wasn't perfect, but it was pretty damn close. Now it's perfect. Enjoy!
[*] [b]Balance Changes[/b] - What do you mean, you didn't like buying 200 upgrades for a tiny improvement? Well fine then, some people just don't appreciate the joys of clicking buttons... I've made the stat upgrades way better. Now you can actually feel the in-game effects of a single purchase. [i]What fun![/i]
[*] [b]Minimap[/b] - Woah! Fancy stuff! If you wanted to find out where those last few Voidlings are in the wave, rather than wandering around aimlessly, we consulted with the electromagnetic super-intelligence of the Void to bring you an aerial image of your surroundings. Get blasting!
[*] [b]Performance Fixes[/b] - The game no longer runs horribly. I do not wish to elaborate further.
[*] [b]Bugfixes, UI Tweaks, Etc...[/b] - The game is just better, Ok? You have to play it to find out.
[/list]

Once again, a big thanks to everyone who has left reviews, supported me, and bug-tested this strange little game. 

Here's to a good 2025! ... ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Onwards! To Lv.1500! ...
notes.content:
If you were worried about the fact that there isn't enough actual content in this game, you should now be less worried. This update brings Voidling Assault up to Lv.1500, although you can play it for longer if you like. 

So what's new? This is new:
[list]
[*] [b]Advanced campaign[/b] - [i]Many new things happen. A lot of things are revealed. Please. plz.[/i]
[*] [b]Qubert becomes a Mercenary[/b] - [i]Qubert will actually join you in Voidling Assault as a fellow fighter, rather than an ambling walker, better known as being a "Scientist" back on the Planet.[/i]
[*] [b]Qubert will demand your money[/b] - [i]Yeah, well, he's not doing all this for free, you know. Qubert actually demands a raise from you.[/i]
[*] [b]New Character: Leadman![/b] - [i]Leadman is a dull, grey, heavier counterpart to the main player character, the Ironman. Please enjoy him to your heart's content, although he does nothing so that might not be very much. Anyway make peace with it? [/i]
[*] [b]Two new achievements[/b] - [i]Sorry achievement hunters, I guess I did just make your job way harder. Well, get to work, I guess.[/i]
[*] [b]A lot of bugfixes and QoL improvements[/b] - [i]More than I have bothered to tabulate in any way, shape, or form, so therefore I cannot consult a list of exactly what else I changed in this update. I changed a lot of things.[/i]
[/list]

Thank you all for playing, and for giving me such valuable feedback to add to the game. It really makes a big difference. :') There's now over 1,000 unique players all-time. That's amazing.

P.S. Yes, I removed the "Idle" game tag, even though this is totally an idle game. You are all wrong. Jk. Love you x

Each denizen of this peaceful planet now remains frozen; trapped inside of the timeless pocket-dimension created by the vicious warlock, Orteil...[/i]

notes.title: NEW: Help Has Arrived!
notes.content:
What??? But it's only been two weeks since the last update!!!

Well I have been working hard in response to your feedback and here is what I've changed.

[list]
[*] [b]Instructions Bar![/b] - A relatively unobtrusive way of telling you what to do. It's a really simple game guys. You literally just shoot things.
[*] [b]Steam Achievements![/b] - Yes! Thank you to that thread on the Discussions page. 
[*] [b]Balancing the Ky Fragment[/b] - I changed the way the scaling works and now it's way better. 
[*] [b]Lv.500+ Unlocked![/b] - Go ahead and play as much as you like. Or don't. Because there's nothing there yet. Unless you want to. But you probably dont haha. unless...? 
[*] [b]Your Save Data Is Safe[/b] - Just trust me and don't ask about it.  it's perfectly safe. This time.
[/list]

Anyway, I'm still working on it. Thank you guys so much for all your feedback, and thanks for playing! I hope you enjoy these changes as much as I enjoyed making it. :D

notes.title: NEW: Leaderboards + Important Fixes!
notes.content:
That's right. I'm not even close to being done. You all thought I'd just publish a game and walk away? Well you'd be wrong. I'm still here. Yes I took a 14 hour day today. Here's what I got done.

[list]
[*] A 'Quit Game' button. No more Alt+F4'ing for you. This fantastic invention is now attainable through all of a single keyboard stroke and one mouse click. 
[*] Leaderboards. You are now allowed - and even encouraged - to compete against your fellow gamers. That is, the other Day 2 fans who come to ULTRAFUN to test their Will & Skill.
[*] Many minor fixes. This includes some glitchy buttons, reset save data not working, and the coin effects on the main menu showing up. You probably won't notice any of these but I did. So I fixed them. 
[/list]

There's still more coming, but I can't tell you when... I need to lay down...
